title: NntpQueue has no dead-letter directory: no operator recovery path
description: SmtpRelayQueue creates a dead/ subdirectory at startup and moves permanently-failed messages there for operator inspection. NntpQueue has no equivalent: DKIM failures loop forever, and if NNTP delivery permanently fails (e.g. 437 duplicate) the message sits in the live queue retrying forever. An operator with a stuck queue has no way to inspect or retire failed messages short of manually deleting files. Scenario: operator reports queue depth stuck at N, articles not delivering — operator has no designated place to look and no self-documenting recovery procedure.
